name: Trade
description: Moves real gold or goods once agreed (a named item at a price agreed in talk is offer_trade; Barter only opens the shop menu); a stranger pays only for what the player handed over first.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - World and Advanced Actions on in Mantella (it names the amount or the item). Followers, friends and lovers give and take freely; a stranger hands over gold or goods only as payment for what you handed them in the same talk. Anything you hand over asks you Yes/No first. offer_trade is for merchants only.

kind.description: give_*: you hand over what you carry; ask_*: the player hands it to you; offer_trade: a merchant sells a named item at the agreed price; take_gift: opens the gift menu.

item.description: Item name, for the item kinds.

price.description: offer_trade: the agreed gold for all of it.

prompt: When the player wants to give you something, begin your response with '{key}:'
